artifacts.summary: Verdict: the paper is right. CN/linear_until is exactly Burgess 1982 A7a (Xu (10)). The Axioms.lean NOTE describes a removed fixed-event mis-transcription. Includes the full Burgess/Xu attribution map, two paper footnote errata (UE, TL/V3) and the docstring text to add.

user_decision.question: The paper's def:BX footnote (outside this repo) has two errors: it says UE follows from UC, but it follows from UG; and it cites Xu frame class V3, which does not exist (TL is Burgess 1984 A2a). Should implementation only record these in paper-definitions-of-record.md, or should you also correct the paper source?
options: Record errata in paper-definitions-of-record.md only; user fixes the paper
user_decision.recommended: Record errata in paper-definitions-of-record.md only; user fixes the paper
